## Change / 修改內容

Describe the problem and the resulting improvement.
請描述原本的問題與修改後的改善。

## Validation / 驗證

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes.
- [ ] Any `SKILL.md` changes are explained, reviewed, and accompanied by an updated `scripts/skill.sha256`.
- [ ] English and Traditional Chinese READMEs are aligned, where applicable.
- [ ] Changed Markdown has been previewed.
- [ ] Installation changes have been tried in a disposable project, if applicable.

For example changes, distinguish proposed prompts from observed results.
修改範例時，請區分建議提示詞與實際觀察到的成果。
